design_philosophy: Warm Italian aesthetic. The design evokes the sensory experience of a rustic yet premium Italian bakery. We prioritize tactile warmth, deep emotional connection through photography, and generous negative space to let the products (Bomboloni & Tiramisu) be the heroes. The admin dashboard shifts to a denser, highly functional layout while maintaining the brand's color palette.

typography.guidelines: Headings must never be pure black; always use #2C241B (Espresso). Use 'font-light' or 'font-medium' for H1/H2 in Cormorant Garamond to maintain elegance. Avoid 'font-black'. Overlines must use the 'small' sizing.

surfaces_and_shadows.storefront_card: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(44,36,27,0.06)] border border-[#E3DCD2]/50 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(44,36,27,0.1)]

motion_and_interactions.button_primary: bg-[#D96C4A] text-white hover:bg-[#C25D3E] hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium
motion_and_interactions.button_secondary: bg-transparent text-[#2C241B] border border-[#2C241B] hover:bg-[#2C241B] hover:text-[#FDFBF7] transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium

strategy.storefront: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for artistic, organic layouts (Hero, Product Grids, Testimonials). Use Shadcn strictly for functional interactions (Cart Sheet, Order Dialog).
strategy.admin: Use heavily customized Shadcn components (Table, Forms, Cards, Select) modified with warm borders and slight border-radius (rounded-lg).

specifics.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header. Links should be subtle with a Terracotta underline on hover.
specifics.hero: Full height or 80vh minimum. Background image must have an overlay of bg-[#2C241B]/30. Text aligned left or center, heavily leaning into Cormorant Garamond.
specifics.product_card: Image dominates (max-h-[300px] object-cover), soft borders, generous internal padding. Action button is secondary until hover.
specifics.cart: Shadcn Sheet. High contrast checkout button.
specifics.admin_sidebar: Solid background (#F4F0E6). Active state indicated by #D96C4A left border or background tint.

icons.guidelines: Use elegant, thin-line icons. Avoid filled icons unless indicating an active state.

images.description: Cozy bakery interior with shelves, warm lighting. Used for the main landing page hero section.
Brown and black donut on white ceramic plate. Used for Bomboloni product showcases.
Piece of cake/tiramisu sitting on top of a white plate. Used for Tiramisu product showcases.
Rustic food context. Can be used for about section or testimonial background with heavy blur/overlay.
Dimly lit bakery with pastries. Great for the 'Our Story' or 'Visit Us' location section.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, cart toggles) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., 'data-testid="add-to-cart-bomboloni"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' in the main HTML/CSS file.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000) anywhere. Default text should be #2C241B.

Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Cart, Admin Panel, Checkout) but strip any harsh vercel-like defaults (sharp corners, pure white/black borders). Apply the warm, rounded-lg and earthy borders specified.
For the marketing pages (home, menu), prioritize pure Tailwind CSS custom layouts to maintain an asymmetric, organic 'bento' feel with generous spacing.
When applying hero images, always use a minimum bg-[#2C241B]/30 overlay to ensure the Cormorant Garamond text remains perfectly readable.
